thread:
kim: Heads up 11 SOC escalated a vuln and wants 30d of debug traces for triage. Our debug index is 14d. I'm proposing a scoped SIEM index with tighter RBAC instead of changing global TTL.

raj: +1. Prefer a separate index: sec-debug-readonly. Access via a role that only SOC and oncall can assume. No global debug bump.

kim: Any concerns about exposed PII in debug payloads?

tom: Yes. Must enforce field-level scrub at ingest. My suggestion: index-time processor that drops session tokens, masks emails, and replaces ips with /24 buckets. Also persist a pseudonym field for user_id.

infra: For lifecycle we can add an index template with ILM set to 30d delete. Also need a small warm-hot split to avoid compaction pain. I can draft the terraform once scrub rules are stable.

legal: If SIEM holds pseudonymized identifiers we need an internal retention policy and a process for re-identification requests with documented justification. Keep legal in the loop for subpoenas.

devsec-bot: Reminder: CMK rotation scheduled 2025-02-01. Any artifacts that require plaintext user mapping must use kms-proxy JIT unwrap. See policy: <https://redwood.internal/policies/kms-unlock>.

raj: Operational idea: store mapping blobs encrypted with CMK per day. Record HMAC(user_id) as user_pseudo in the index. For re-identification open a forensics ticket, KMS proxy grants ephemeral access to decrypt the days needed. All actions logged.

kim: That meets SOC speed needs while limiting exposure. SOC: can you accept pseudonyms for realtime triage and use JIT for identity resolution?

(2:sec-analyst): Pseudonyms + trace_id are OK for most triage. We do need raw payload access for the first 7d for replay, after that only metadata. Will file a signed justification if you need it.

tom: Note on exports: any Splunk/SIEM export must be wrapped with envelope keys and have ticket id in object metadata. No local plaintext copies without sec-approval.

infra: Also worth adding an ingestion test harness to validate scrub rules against sampled payloads before rollout. Prevents dropping useful fields.

legal: Add a periodic audit of who performed re-identifications and a retention log entry. Retention exceptions must be tracked in the policy exception registry.

kim: Action items: 1) tom -> prototype index-time scrub rules + test harness; 2) raj -> RBAC role + assume policy draft; 3) infra -> ILM template + Terraform stub; 4) legal -> re-id policy text; 5) devsec-bot -> update kms-proxy playbook link in the ticket template.

kim: I'll open the change request once tom posts the scrub examples. Thanks :thumbsup:
